sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Scope evaluation to the authoritative ship target. Remove sh:targetClass from gen:StructuralMemberShape and gen:LocalFrameSectionCalculationCaseShape; the current global targets evaluate arbitrary members/cases independently of a ship, while gen:ShipShape only applies a generic calculation-case shape and never reaches the formula constraints. From gen:ShipShape, traverse nltl:hasCalculationCase and conditionally apply gen:LocalFrameSectionCalculationCaseShape to represented local-frame section cases. Also enforce that each such case is the same node linked from its nltl:sectionCalculationCaseStructuralMember via nltl:hasLocalFrameSectionCalculationCase; do not merely validate unrelated values of that member-side property. This can be done with one bounded relationship-coherence query using the already supplied terms. Preserve the existing property owners, applicability comparison, formulas, tolerances, interpolation branch, datatypes, and units, and do not add existence cardinality for a universal ship-to-case rule unless independently required.

Preserve the authoritative ship-only scope, ship-to-case traversal, same-case member back-link coherence, existing owners, applicability comparison, formulas, tolerances, branches, datatypes, and units, without adding sh:minCount to hasCalculationCase. Repair the accidental pass when netWebThickness is zero: the neutral-axis BIND divides by zero before the later disjunction can report it, so explicitly return a violation for zero denominator and evaluate the formula only for nonzero thickness. Also replace the repeated existential FILTER NOT EXISTS datatype/unit/presence queries with scoped SHACL Core constraints and consolidate formula/branch evaluation into one bounded SPARQL query; the current existential joins can accept one conforming value combination while ignoring additional malformed values and are needlessly combinatorial.
